name: St. Mary's Junior Academy Kisaasi
description: Primary & Nursery School in Kampala - UNEB Center, Day & Boarding, Swimming, ICT

data.badge: Admissions Open — Nursery to P.7 • 2027 Intake
data.title: Nurturing Tomorrow's Leaders with Discipline & Excellence
data.subtitle: Holistic UNEB curriculum delivered by dedicated graduate teachers, a modern computer lab, swimming, music, and secure school van transport across Kampala. Day and boarding options available. MTN MoMo & Airtel Money accepted.

data.heading: Academic Sections & Termly Tuition
data.subheading: All tuition packages include daily balanced lunch, mid-morning milk, textbook access, and co-curricular sports.

services.name: Daycare & Nursery (Baby / Middle / Top)
services.description: Jolly phonics, early numeracy, sensory development, social skills, and creative play in safe classrooms.

services.name: Lower Primary (P.1 – P.3)
services.description: Foundational literacy, mathematics, integrated science, social studies, and swimming instruction.

services.name: Upper Primary & UNEB (P.4 – P.7)
services.description: Rigorous academic preparation with evening revision clinics, debate clubs, and science practicals.

services.name: Safe School Van Transport
services.description: Door-to-door morning pickup and evening drop-off covering Kisaasi, Ntinda, Bukoto, and Kulambiro.

services.name: ICT & Computer Literacy Lab
services.description: Hands-on computer training, typing skills, coding basics, and digital research in air-conditioned lab.

services.name: Music, Dance, Drama & Swimming
services.description: Professional coaching in piano, traditional brass band, swimming gala, and national MDD competitions.

data.heading: Campus Life & Co-Curriculars
data.subheading: Moments from science fairs, sports days, traditional dance, ICT lessons, and P.7 graduation ceremonies.

data.heading: Termly Tuition & Enrollment Packages
data.subheading: Flexible installment plans available via MTN MoMo and SchoolPay.

plans.name: Nursery & Kindergarten
features: Daily rest time in clean beds

data.heading: What Parents Say
data.subheading: Feedback from parents whose children study at St. Mary's Junior Academy.

testimonials.name: Eng. Robert K.
testimonials.text: Both my children scored aggregate 4 in mock exams. The teachers are dedicated and follow up on each child personally.

testimonials.name: Harriet N.
testimonials.text: My son could read full English sentences at age 4 thanks to the nursery Jolly Phonics curriculum. Fantastic school!

testimonials.name: Dr. Florence M.
testimonials.text: Clean environment, nutritious meals, and the school van is always punctual. Highly recommend to any parent in Kampala.
